policy_assessments.claim: HTTPcore async connection establishment retry boundary
policy_assessments.scope: One AsyncHTTPConnection._connect invocation, retries=0, caught ConnectError/ConnectTimeout at this layer.
policy_assessments.evidence: AsyncConnectionPool stores retries and passes it to direct AsyncHTTPConnection. _connect copies self._retries; when a caught connection failure occurs with retries_left<=0 it raises before decrement/backoff/sleep. Thus zero permits no second backend connect call in that failure branch.
policy_assessments.limit: This is one backend invocation, not proof of one physical address/socket attempt inside an uncaptured network backend, nor blanket no-replay/no-reassignment across the pool. HTTPS/TLS failure is within the same caught retry boundary but the supplied tests cover synthetic HTTP connect failures, not actual TLS.

policy_assessments.claim: Zero retries forbids all pool request reassignment
policy_assessments.evidence: AsyncConnectionPool.handle_async_request loops, catches ConnectionNotAvailable, clears the assigned connection and tries assignment again independently of self._retries.
policy_assessments.limit: The captured pool proves reassignment exists; it does not prove a request was already transmitted or replayed. No such traffic or effect was observed. Do not equate reassignment with proven duplicate business execution.

policy_assessments.claim: One SQL call or one Psycopg connect API invocation guarantees one underlying connection attempt
policy_assessments.evidence: conninfo.py reexports _conninfo_attempts.conninfo_attempts and uses _conninfo_utils. split_attempts handles host/hostaddr lists. _resolve_hostnames returns one mapping per getaddrinfo result; one hostname may yield several address attempts. Captured synchronous Connection.connect iterates attempts, continues on selected connection exceptions and stops on success.
policy_assessments.limit: Multiple attempts are possible, not observed at runtime and not inevitable. Explicit hostaddr suppresses this helper's DNS expansion but split host lists and downstream behavior still need their own scoped facts. get_param may fall back to PG* environment defaults. No live DNS, credentials or DB call was made.

policy_assessments.evidence: The ordinary single-worker Server path calls config.load(), constructs the lifespan implementation, then awaits startup. Config.load imports protocol classes, lifespan class and application through import_from_string (importlib.import_module plus attribute lookup), and may invoke the loaded object as a factory. LifespanOn schedules the application's lifespan callable and dispatches startup before ordinary listener creation. Logging, event-loop setup, signal handling, application initialization and listening are effects, not effect-free startup.
policy_assessments.limit: For reload or workers>1, main.run binds a supervisor socket before running worker Server instances, so import/lifespan-before-listen is not universal. In lifespan=auto, an unsupported/erroring lifespan can be treated as unsupported rather than requiring exit; do not infer universal fail-closed startup. No whole import-closure audit or startup success is claimed.

policy_assessments.claim: Effective Uvicorn startup profile is bound by the eight captured paths
policy_assessments.evidence: main declares Click auto_envvar_prefix=UVICORN and UVICORN_APP. Config reads WEB_CONCURRENCY when workers is None, FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS when unspecified and optional env_file. run selects reload/multiprocess/single-worker branches and can remove a configured UDS on exit. Logging configuration can read files and configure handlers. Captured paths explain branches but do not bind effective values.
policy_assessments.required_proof: Bind the exact intended command plus non-secret effective values/presence controls for relevant UVICORN_* and WEB_CONCURRENCY inputs, reload/workers, app/factory, env-file/log-config, fd/uds and lifespan before a scoped entrypoint approval. Do not assume missing values are absent or change the reviewed contract to satisfy a loader.
policy_assessments.limit: This is an effective-profile evidence gap, not a request for actual startup, credential reads, unrestricted environment capture, exhaustive SDK closure or cutover.
